item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 6 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 6-A #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 12:47 PM, 17 August 2026(Monday)

RED WARNING LEVEL: Bataan, Metro Manila, Zambales(Subic, Olongapo, San Antonio, Castillejos), Pampanga(Floridablanca, Lubao, Sasmuan, Macabebe, Masantol), Bulacan(Obando, Bulakan, Malolos, Meycauayan, Hagonoy, Paombong), Rizal(San Mateo, Rodriguez) and Cavite(Bacoor, Cavite City, Imus, Kawit, Noveleta, Rosario).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: Serious FLOODING is expected in flood-prone areas.

ORANGE WARNING LEVEL: Zambales(Botolan, San Marcelino, Cabangan, Candelaria, Iba, Masinloc, Palauig, Santa Cruz, San Felipe, San Narciso), Pampanga(Porac, Minalin, Guagua, Santa Rita), Rizal(Antipolo, Cainta, Taytay), Bulacan(Balagtas, Bocaue, Calumpit, Guiguinto, Marilao, Plaridel, San Jose del Monte, Santa Maria), Cavite(General Trias, Tanza, Naic, General Emilio Aguinaldo, Magallanes, Maragondon, Ternate, Trece Martires, Dasmarinas, Gen. Mariano Alvarez), Batangas(Nasugbu, Balayan, Calatagan, Lian, Tuy) and Laguna(San Pedro).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING is THREATENING.

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Tarlac(Mayantoc, San Clemente, Santa Ignacia, Camiling, Bamban, Capas, San Jose), Pampanga(Apalit, Bacolor, San Fernando, Mexico, San Luis, San Simon, Santa Ana, Santo Tomas, Angeles, Mabalacat), Rizal(Tanay, Angono, Baras, Binangonan, Cardona, Jala-Jala, Morong, Pililla, Teresa), Laguna(Santa Maria, Mabitac, Famy, Cabuyao, Santa Rosa, Binan, Siniloan, Pangil, Pakil), Quezon(Infanta, General Nakar), Bulacan(Angat, Baliuag, Bustos, Norzagaray, Pandi, Pulilan, Dona Remedios Trinidad, San Rafael), Cavite(Carmona, Indang, Amadeo, Mendez, Silang, Tagaytay, Alfonso) and Batangas(Calaca, Laurel, Lemery).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.


Meanwhile, light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Nueva Ecija, Quezon(Real, Candelaria, Dolores, San Antonio, Sariaya, Tiaong, Tayabas, Lucban, Lucena, Mauban, Pagbilao, Sampaloc, Agdangan, Alabat, Atimonan, Buenavista, Burdeos, Calauag, Catanauan, General Luna, Guinayangan, Gumaca, Jomalig, Lopez, Macalelon, Mulanay, Padre Burgos, Panukulan, Patnanungan, Perez, Pitogo, Plaridel, Polillo, Quezon, San Andres, San Francisco, San Narciso, Tagkawayan, Unisan), Laguna(Alaminos, Bay, Calauan, Liliw, Los Banos, Luisiana, Magdalena, Majayjay, Nagcarlan, Pagsanjan, Pila, Rizal, San Pablo, Santa Cruz, Victoria, Cavinti, Kalayaan, Lumban, Paete, Calamba), Bulacan(San Ildefonso, San Miguel), Pampanga(Arayat, Candaba, Magalang), Tarlac(Concepcion, Anao, Tarlac City, Gerona, La Paz, Paniqui, Pura, Ramos, San Manuel, Victoria, Moncada) and Batangas(Alitagtag, Batangas City, Bauan, Cuenca, Ibaan, Lipa, Lobo, Mabini, Mataasnakahoy, Padre Garcia, Rosario, San Jose, San Juan, San Luis, San Pascual, Santa Teresita, Santo Tomas, Taal, Taysan, Tingloy, Balete, Tanauan, Malvar, Agoncillo, San Nicolas, Talisay) which may persist within 3 hours.
The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 2:00 PM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to www.pagasa.dost.gov.ph.
